notes.title: Read before you buy
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Avalon Lords community,[/h3]

It has been a long, eventful journey since [i]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/i] first entered Early Access back in 2016. Over the years we faced challenges, made mistakes and learned invaluable lessons along the way. Last year, we made the difficult decision to temporarily remove the game from the Steam store to embark on a complete rebuild. And during the upcoming Steam RTS Fest we are excited to share [b]the first iteration[/b] of that process. If you are interested in testing it out, please read on to ensure you know what to expect.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/8b474e356d05ec060694d5654488cb121de025c0.png[/img]

[h3]The Rebuild: A New Beginning[/h3]
[i]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/i] has been rebuilt from the ground up by a small, but passionate team of original and new developers. This is not a re-release of the old game but the beginning of an entirely new saga. While we’ve made significant progress, we want to be upfront: [b]this is just the start.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/8b474e356d05ec060694d5654488cb121de025c0.png[/img]

[h3]What to expect[/h3]
To set expectations correctly, here’s what the first iteration of the new build will contain:

[b]A barebones Experience:[/b] The current version prioritizes core mechanics and stability over features and polish. Many systems are still in development and you’ll encounter placeholders and unfinished elements.

[b]Foundational Gameplay:[/b] Expect minimal content at this stage. This release is focused on getting the basics right before expanding further. You can test the first mission of the campaign and test the systems in skirmishes. Multiplayer is available but is not properly balanced or polished.

[b]Transparency Commitment:[/b] We’re committed to being open about the state of the game. While it is playable, it is not a full-fledged experience yet. Think of it as the foundation of what’s to come. 
[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/329280/view/499436070246548754](Check out our Roadmap for 2025)[/url][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/8b474e356d05ec060694d5654488cb121de025c0.png[/img]

[h3]Why release now?[/h3]
After being in bad shape for years and basically unplayable since we pulled it from the store, we felt it was essential to make something accessible again for those who have already supported us. By releasing the game during the Steam RTS Fest, we hope to re-engage with our community and invite new players to be part of this rebuilding process. It goes without questions that early supporters [b]do not have to buy the game or any content again.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/8b474e356d05ec060694d5654488cb121de025c0.png[/img]

[h3]Your Role in Shaping the Game[/h3]
We’re taking a community-centered development approach, and your feedback will play a critical role in shaping the future of Avalon Lords. Here is how you can help:

[list]
[*] Share your thoughts on gameplay mechanics, features and balance.
[*] Report bugs and technical issues to help us improve stability.
[*] Suggest ideas for future content and improvements.
[/list]This is your opportunity to influence the direction of the game early on.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/8b474e356d05ec060694d5654488cb121de025c0.png[/img]

[h3]Important Considerations[/h3]
[b]Understand the Risks:[/b] If you are considering purchasing the game now, please do so with the understanding that this is an evolving project. This version is not for everyone and that’s ok.

[b]Play now or Wait:[/b] If you prefer a polished experience, we recommend waiting for further updates. However, if you are excited to be part of the game’s growth and want to contribute, we’d love to have you on board.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/8b474e356d05ec060694d5654488cb121de025c0.png[/img]

[h3]Honoring Our Early Supporters[/h3]
To those who supported us during the original release, we extend our deepest gratitude. Your patience and understanding mean the world to us. We are committed to delivering value over time and ensuring your investment in Avalon Lords is respected.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/8b474e356d05ec060694d5654488cb121de025c0.png[/img]

[h3]Join Us for the Steam RTS Fest[/h3]
The next chapter of [i]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/i] begins during the Steam RTS Fest. We are excited to reintroduce the game and invite you to experience this new beginning. Stay tuned for updates and announcements in the weeks to come.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/8b474e356d05ec060694d5654488cb121de025c0.png[/img]

Thank you for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to hear your feedback and work together to make Avalon Lords the game we all envision.

With gratitude,
[i]The Avalon Lords Development Team[/i]

notes.title: 2025 Roadmap: The Path ahead for Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises
notes.content:
[h2]Lords and Ladies of Avalon,[/h2]

Before you can take a look at the first iteration of rebuilding [i]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/i], we will share our plans for the future. This year, we aim to expand your experience with new features, legendary heroes, and an epic campaign story. 

Here’s a closer look at the road ahead:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/b96e2b0745d3576cd49af24b53b83cbf7297aa24.png[/img]


[h3]⚔️ Battle System Upgrades[/h3]
As a first goal, we will refine the foundations of warfare to give you greater control on the battlefield:
[list]
[*] [b]Formations:[/b] Fine-tune your strategies with finalized formations, enabling your armies to maneuver with precision and execute tactics effectively.
[*] [b]Ultimate Spells:[/b] Unleash devastating magical abilities to turn the tide of battle.
[*] [b]Spectator Mode:[/b] Dive into the action like never before, watch battles unfold, and learn from the strategies of others.
[/list]
[h3]🏰 Hero System Expansion[/h3]
Once the foundations are solid, the world of Avalon will be enriched with legendary figures from its lore, and they’re ready to join your cause. Heroes coming to the game include:
[list]
[*] [b]Merlin [/b]- The wise and powerful wizard.
[*] [b]Arthur [/b]- The destined leader of Avalon.
[*] [b]Lancelot[/b] - The valiant knight.
[*] [b]Guinevere [/b]- The queen of Avalon.
[*] [b]Morgana[/b] - The leader of the Darkness.
[*] [b]Mordred[/b] – The dark knight and nemesis of Arthur.
[*]and many more…
[/list]As heroes emerge, they will redefine your approach to battles, campaigns, and strategy. Choose wisely who will lead your armies to glory!


[h3]🌍 Multiplayer and Translations[/h3]
The next goal will then be to solidify replayability and strengthen the community with new multiplayer content:
[list]
[*] Three New Maps for multiplayer and skirmish modes, offering fresh challenges and new terrain to conquer.
[*] Multilingual Translations: Avalon will welcome players from across the world with additional support for [b]Russian, Chinese, and Korean[/b].
[/list]
[h3]📜 Campaign Storyline[/h3]
The first version of [i]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/i] includes only the opening mission of Chapter One, offering a glimpse of what’s to come. Once we’re satisfied with the game’s overall state, the true journey through Avalon will begin! The campaign is the core of [i]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/i], divided into [b]four chapters[/b], each featuring approximately [b]five thrilling missions[/b]. 

Our initial focus will be on completing Chapters One and Two, which we plan to release together in one major update. This update will include cinematics, voice-overs, and an engaging storyline to immerse players in the rich world of Avalon.

Afterward, we will turn our efforts to finalize the campaign with Chapters Three and Four, completing the epic narrative in a subsequent update.


[b]Which feature excites you the most?[/b] 
💬 Share your thoughts with the community, and together, let’s shape the future of Avalon.

~ The Avalon Lords Team

notes.title: December Update: Preparing Avalon Lords for a Bold Rebirth in January!
notes.content:
Greetings, Avalon Lords community!

Since our last update in August, we’ve made significant strides in bringing Avalon Lords closer to the rebirth it deserves. Our team has been working tirelessly to refine the game, and today, we want to share the progress we’ve made and what lies ahead.

[h2]What We’ve Accomplished Since August:[/h2]

Here are some highlights of the work completed since our last update:

[list]
[*] Combat Improvements: Addressed and fixed bugs like units not properly attacking enemies in missions, ensuring smoother gameplay.
[*] Enhanced Tutorials: Redesigned tutorial screens to guide players more effectively, including updates like adjusting Peace Time mechanics.
[*] Loading Screen Enhancements: Introduced a brand-new loading screen for a more immersive and polished experience.
[*] Visual Updates: Added a sleek 3D logo to the main menu for a fresh, modern feel.
[*] Animations: Reanimated core models, including the peasant unit, for more lifelike movements and dynamic interactions.
[*] UI and Sound Pass: Continued refining UI elements and sound effects to ensure consistency and improve player immersion.
[/list]

And this is just scratching the surface! The team has been methodically polishing every aspect of the game to ensure it’s in a state we can be proud of.

[h3]The Road Ahead: January Release Target[/h3]

We’re excited to announce that we are targeting January 2024 for the release of the newly rebuilt version of Avalon Lords during the Steam Strategy Fest. However, this will only happen if the game meets our expectations of quality and polish. As always, our commitment is to "do it right this time." If the game isn’t ready, we won’t rush the release. Your understanding and patience mean the world to us as we push to deliver the experience Avalon Lords deserves.


[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]

We’re currently in the final stages of preparing for broader playtesting to ensure the gameplay, mechanics, and experience all align with the vision we’ve rebuilt from the ground up. This includes:

[list]
[*] Fine-tuning unit AI, particularly combat mechanics and pathfinding.
[*] Testing the first chapter of the single-player campaign to ensure it captures the depth and excitement of the Avalon Lords story.
[*] Continued improvements to UI, sound, and visuals across the board.
[/list]

Thank you for sticking with us on this journey. The time and effort we’ve poured into this project are all for one goal: to bring Avalon Lords back better than ever. Keep an eye out for updates as we approach January, and don’t hesitate to share your thoughts, feedback, or questions. Your support keeps us motivated!

Stay tuned for more soon, and as always…

For Avalon!

notes.title: Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises Update - Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Lords and Ladies of Avalon! We're excited to bring you the latest update for Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises, version 1.2.0. Here's what's new in this release:

Water Units Make a Splash: We've started adding water units to the game, expanding your strategic options both on land and now at sea.

Townhall Transformation: Enjoy fresh designs for the townhall, adding more variety and visual appeal to your cities.

Smooth Sailing with Nav Mesh: We're actively working on nav meshing for water units, ensuring they navigate the aquatic terrain with finesse.

Welcome the Naval Yard: You can now build a naval yard to construct powerful naval forces and dominate the seas.

Rivers Reimagined: We've rebuilt the river in the game and added realistic water sound effects, including the soothing crash of waves on the beaches. Dive into the dynamic flow of our revitalized river systems.

Take to the Skies: With navmeshing for aerial units introduced, your flying troops will find their paths more intelligently.

Look to the Sky in 1.3: While aerial units are now better supported, keep an eye out for structures tailored for flying units coming in version 1.3.

URP Pipeline Enhancement: The Universal Render Pipeline (URP) has been globally introduced, enhancing performance across the board for a smoother gaming experience.

Map Makeover: We're embarking on a journey to redesign the game map, focusing on intricate details to elevate your immersion in the world of Avalon.

We're thrilled to share these updates with you as we continue to refine and expand Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises. Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping these improvements, and we can't wait to see how you'll conquer the newly expanded seas and landscapes. Stay tuned for more exciting developments, and thank you for your continued support!

Published by Avalon Chronicles on June 9th, 2023

Calling all brave warriors and strategists! Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey as we unveil the exciting features of our upcoming game, "Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises." Prepare to immerse yourself in a realm of heroes, mythical creatures, and epic battles against the forces of darkness. Here's a sneak peek into what awaits you:

First let us show you our new song addition for Avalon Lords, Rise Up! 

[previewyoutube=9ki31sUjILs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Upcoming Brand New Game Features[/h2]
1. [b]Rise of King Arthur:[/b] Witness the legendary return of King Arthur, summoned from the spirit realm by the powerful wizard Merlin. Take control of the once and future king himself as he leads the charge against The Darkness, wielding his mighty sword Excalibur.

[b]2. Strategic Base Management:[/b] Build and manage your own strategic stronghold as you prepare to face the forces of evil. Gather resources, construct buildings, train troops, and fortify defenses to withstand the relentless assaults of The Darkness.

[b]3. Hero Units and Knight Recruitment: [/b]As King Arthur, recruit and command the legendary Knights of the Round Table. Each knight possesses unique abilities and upgrades, allowing for a diverse and powerful army. Unleash devastating special attacks and strategically deploy your heroes to turn the tide of battle.

[b]4. Engaging Campaign Mode: [/b]Experience a rich and immersive single-player campaign as you follow the epic story of King Arthur's quest to vanquish The Darkness. Engage in a series of challenging missions, uncover ancient secrets, forge alliances, and lead your forces to reclaim the once-great city of Camelot.

[b]5. Real-time Strategy Battles:[/b] Engage in intense and strategic real-time battles against the forces of darkness. Command your armies, unleash powerful spells, and tactically maneuver your troops on the battlefield to achieve victory. Every decision counts as you face off against the corrupted minions of The Darkness.

[b]6. Uncover the Mysteries of Avalon:[/b] Explore mystical locations, delve into ancient ruins, and unravel the secrets of Avalon. Discover hidden artifacts, encounter mythical creatures, and harness powerful magical abilities to aid you in your quest.

[b]7. Customize and Upgrade:[/b] Enhance your army and heroes through a robust customization and upgrade system. Unlock new abilities, upgrade equipment, and strengthen your forces to become an unstoppable force against The Darkness.

[b]8. Multiplayer Warfare:[/b] Test your strategic skills and compete against players from around the world in intense multiplayer battles. Form alliances, wage wars, and prove your dominance on the global leaderboard.

[b]9. Stunning Visuals and Immersive Sound:[/b] Immerse yourself in the world of Avalon with stunning visuals, richly detailed environments, and captivating sound effects that bring the realm to life.

[b]10. Ongoing Content Updates:[/b] The adventure doesn't end with the campaign! Expect regular content updates, including new missions, challenges, units, and features, ensuring that the realm of Avalon is ever-evolving and filled with new surprises.

Prepare to be captivated by the epic tale of King Arthur and his valiant quest to restore light and hope to Avalon. "Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises" promises to deliver a thrilling and immersive real-time strategy experience like no other. Stay tuned for more updates and be prepared to rise against The Darkness!

[b]Keep in mind, this is a completely rebranded game, and rebuilt from the ground up!. [/b]

We also are reopening our discord for those wanting to hang out. 
[url=https://discord.gg/M9ctN5GAXq]Join Animus Discord[/url]

notes.title: Avalonian 1.0 Mega Patch Progress
notes.content:

[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/85efe0229bb46ef2a32540bd4e10299bde903d9c.png[/img]

notes.title: Avalonian 1.0.0A MEGA PATCH IN THE WORKS
notes.content:
So I started over from the drawing board on what makes an RTS really shine? Went back to the basics. That is exactly where Avalon Lords will start. The bare bone basics. So what is in the works and what is new and different from the predecessor?

[previewyoutube=gN2kzw0w6Lc;full][/previewyoutube]


For one brand new music that is scored for the entire game and sfx. This is not major for gameplay but it does help. Secondary for our new gaming systems. 

The old game looked old, and frankly had graphics from god knows when we started. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/04d85db6c6deb368dc5967d778ba3a903359db14.png[/img]

Well with the new upgrades coming everything is upgraded with a new modern system, that will really let you zoom so close you can see the very stalks of wheat for your new farms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11595822/5012520e949301834c0ce0bba5908cdf8aba0f5f.png[/img]


We have more upgrades here coming and reworks completely.

[olist]
[*] Walls system completely trashed and reworked
[*] AI Interaction completely rebuilt for combat
[*] Bots are very smart now and aggressive
[*] New buildings, to help enhance the gameplay.
[*] Builds Actually slowly detoriate as you destroy them and not just a regular animation sprite. 
[*] Real Fog Of War
[*] Campaign System in place, to make campaigns
[*] Aerial Units
[/olist]


Now I can keep talking about this. But we have decided to try to put an aggressive timeline on this re-release of this ALPHA Mega Patch. So we are looking to do it by July. 

Now to be fully upfront, this is not the same size team. This is going to feel like a completely new game as well. 

This will be a iterative process that I can't wait to be apart of with you.

notes.title: New Game Update Released - New Map Art!!!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11595822/d712420c8548833479c8ff4afb07496c08073f1b.jpg[/img]

Hi everybody! We know it has been a little while since our last game update, but that does not mean we have been sitting idle. A whole lot has been happening behind the scenes here and we are finally ready to push out our latest fixes and additions!

Here’s some of the goodies in this next release:

[H1]Increased Troop Size 4x[/H1] We know that previously the battles seemed at times like a war of flags since you couldn’t see your troops after a certain point of zooming out. Now you should be able to see them no matter what height you have the camera!

[H1]Increase Troop Movement Speed[/H1] We have also upped the movement rate of all troops which helps to speed up the game and crush your enemies that much faster.

[H1]Reduced Charge By 1.5%[/H1] Due to the overall increase in troops speed, their charge speed has been reduced a bit to compensate.

[H1]Reduced Camera Zoom Out Max Distance nd Reduce Camera Zoom In Max Distance[/H1] We continue to play around with these settings until we get them just right. We think we are close to the sweet spot now, what do you all think?

[H1]Increase Spacing Between Troops[/H1] With the troops themselves larger, we had to alter the spacing between troops so they weren’t standing on top of each other any more.

[H1]Increased Ballista Size 4x Original Size[/H1] It was easy to lose track of your ballista before, now it’s much easier to find it when you need it!

[H1]Increased Trebuchet Size By 1x[/H1] These were pretty big to begin with by comparison, still we upped their size a bit as well.

[H1]Increased Catapult Size By 2x[/H1] Same as all the others, picking out that catapult should be no problem no matter what height your camera is at.

[H1]Increased Trebuchet Speed Movement Speed By 4x[/H1] These were painfully slow before, but now they should keep up with the rest of your troops.

[H1]Increased Catapult Speed By 5x[/H1] I always liked the catapult myself, a good blend of power and speed. Faster catapults with which I can rain down more destruction? Yes please!

[H1]Increased Ballista Speed By 6x[/H1] What real use was an anti-infantry and anti-siege weapon when it took so long to get on the battlefield? Keep a close eye out for these little treats.
 
[H1]Working Of Fixed Reconnection Failures To Games[/H1] While not totally repaired at this point, we have added a notification for people so they at least know what the hang up is here.

[H1]Fixed Game Crashing At Checking For Your Profile[/H1] Some people were having some connection problems. Hopefully we have fixed that now. Please give things a try and let us know if you still have any problems.

[H1]Redone Textures For Scattered Islands Map[/H1] This is one of our larger changes for this update. Please try out a couple matches on the Shattered Islands map which has gone through the first pass of a visual makeover. What do you think of the art direction?

[H1]Land Bridges On Scattered Islands Swapped With Real Bridges[/H1] Along with the texture makeover of this map, we are changing out some of the other art and model assets. How do you like seeing real bridges between the islands?

[H1]AI Should Attack Walls When They Are Blocking It's Path[/H1] A little bump in the AI for troops. They should now attack any walls that are blocking their path instead of walking all the way around them.

[H1]Research Queue Bug That Could Cause Negative Resources / Infinite Resources Fixed[/H1] This one was quite bad for people who suddenly found themselves with a sever lack of resources on hand. However, those who figured out how to essentially get infinite resources will be disappointed here.. 

[H1]When Hiding Interface Using Shift+Esc, Unit Flag Icons Will Also Hide[/H1] This one has been long requested by a bunch of people. Well, we finally got it to be a thing. Now lets see some of those amazing (GUI-free) screenshots!

Well, that’s it for now my friends. Again, please let us know what you think of the new art and camera controls. Thank you very much to everybody who has been providing excellent feedback, suggestions and bug reports. We will keep at it as we go through the list of things on our plate. Look forward to more updates and more announcements coming soon!

Thanks everybody. For Avalon!

notes.title: Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises Roadmap – Where Are We Going From Here?
notes.content:
[h1]Good day my friends![/h1]

The staff here at Animus has been pretty busy behind the scenes thanks to all the great feedback and suggestions we have been given. It is all really appreciated, please keep it coming. We wanted to give you a peek at where we are looking to take Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises, so this post here will serve as a sort of “roadmap” for the future. To be clear, any of this may be changed, added to, subtracted from, etc., as we go through the Early Access phase. Your thoughts and suggestions on all this are valued, so please share them and comment on our forums!

[h1]Empire Mode/Matchmaking[/h1]

We know that Empire mode doesn't really do all that much at the moment and we have received some excellent suggestions as to how it can be improved. Since we are a very small team of less than 10 people, we need to prioritize our energies. As such, we will temporarily be disabling the Empire mode and instead replace it with a more straightforward matchmaking system that will allow people to get to the action quickly. Don't fear though, Empire mode will return when we can get it to a point where it is a lot more fun. [b][STATUS: On Hold][/b]

[h1]Battle Mode[/h1]

In a similar vein as above, Battle mode will be disabled. [b][STATUS: On Hold][/b]

[h1]Practice Mode[/h1]

For the same reasons of being able to concentrate our efforts, Practice mode will be disabled until we can get a proper Tutorial level going.[b] [STATUS: On Hold][/b]

[h1]Factions[/h1]

Since Empire mode is taking a back seat for a bit, we are also going to remove the concept of the Factions. There was some confusion as to the differences between them, and outside of Empire mode they don't serve a game purpose. They were meant to be sub-factions of the same group of people, more like a Greek city-state, but they kept being confused with the idea of a “faction” in a more traditional sense. To avoid that confusion, we will simply remove them. Which leads me to what we will replace them with… [b][STATUS: Removed][/b]

[h1]New Factions/Orders[/h1]

For anybody who has read about the game world history, you will see that we have in mind three Great Orders, being Dawn, Darkness and Divine. These are “factions” in the more proper sense (different troops types, building types, etc). The Order of Dawn is the “poster boy” faction, while they do have some magical ability they concentrate more on martial aspects coupled with speed and agility. The Order of Darkness values brute strength combined with advanced (medieval) technology to give them the edge over others. Finally the Order of Divine favors magical power over all other things, even their basic foot soldiers have some very basic talent. Currently the troops/buildings in the game are from the Order of Dawn and for the moment it will remain that way as we develop things. The other two Orders will be added later on.[b] [STATUS: Upcoming][/b]

[h1]Music/Soundtrack[/h1]

We are pleased and honored to say that we have a world-famous composer currently working on the soundtrack for the game. I can’t quite say just yet who that person is (stay tuned for an upcoming announcement on that!), but I can say this person has done the soundtracks for a couple other games you have all heard of and the soundtracks for those games are so good that professional orchestras perform them around the world.[b] [STATUS: Under Development][/b]

[h1]Art[/h1]

We have recently expanded our team to include a new artist. We will announce him more formally soon (Peter wants to get some more concept art completed first). He comes as a personal recommendation by the Art Director of another very well-known game I am sure you have all heard of. The general art direction will be updated graphics to be more in line with other modern games people are playing. First we are starting with the buildings and then our thought is to redo terrain followed by the various troops themselves. [b][STATUS: Under Development][/b]

[h1][b]UI/HUD[/b][/h1]

Our Game Designer has been hard at work retooling the way the GUI is set up. We are going to do a complete overhaul of the whole thing, including the General Lobby, the Match Lobby as well as the in game HUD. We have been getting a lot of great suggestions on how this should be set up and I think people will be pleased by what they see. [b][STATUS: Under Development][/b]

[h1]Gameplay Features[/h1]

notes.title: Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises Roadmap – Where Are We Going From Here?
notes.content:
[h1]Good day my friends![/h1]

The staff here at Animus has been pretty busy behind the scenes thanks to all the great feedback and suggestions we have been given. It is all really appreciated, please keep it coming. We wanted to give you a peek at where we are looking to take Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises, so this post here will serve as a sort of “roadmap” for the future. To be clear, any of this may be changed, added to, subtracted from, etc., as we go through the Early Access phase. Your thoughts and suggestions on all this are valued, so please share them and comment on our forums!

[h1]Empire Mode/Matchmaking[/h1]

We know that Empire mode doesn't really do all that much at the moment and we have received some excellent suggestions as to how it can be improved. Since we are a very small team of less than 10 people, we need to prioritize our energies. As such, we will temporarily be disabling the Empire mode and instead replace it with a more straightforward matchmaking system that will allow people to get to the action quickly. Don't fear though, Empire mode will return when we can get it to a point where it is a lot more fun. [b][STATUS: On Hold][/b]

[h1]Battle Mode[/h1]

In a similar vein as above, Battle mode will be disabled. [b][STATUS: On Hold][/b]

[h1]Practice Mode[/h1]

For the same reasons of being able to concentrate our efforts, Practice mode will be disabled until we can get a proper Tutorial level going.[b] [STATUS: On Hold][/b]

[h1]Factions[/h1]

Since Empire mode is taking a back seat for a bit, we are also going to remove the concept of the Factions. There was some confusion as to the differences between them, and outside of Empire mode they don't serve a game purpose. They were meant to be sub-factions of the same group of people, more like a Greek city-state, but they kept being confused with the idea of a “faction” in a more traditional sense. To avoid that confusion, we will simply remove them. Which leads me to what we will replace them with… [b][STATUS: Removed][/b]

[h1]New Factions/Orders[/h1]

For anybody who has read about the game world history, you will see that we have in mind three Great Orders, being Dawn, Darkness and Divine. These are “factions” in the more proper sense (different troops types, building types, etc). The Order of Dawn is the “poster boy” faction, while they do have some magical ability they concentrate more on martial aspects coupled with speed and agility. The Order of Darkness values brute strength combined with advanced (medieval) technology to give them the edge over others. Finally the Order of Divine favors magical power over all other things, even their basic foot soldiers have some very basic talent. Currently the troops/buildings in the game are from the Order of Dawn and for the moment it will remain that way as we develop things. The other two Orders will be added later on.[b] [STATUS: Upcoming][/b]

[h1]Music/Soundtrack[/h1]

We are pleased and honored to say that we have a world-famous composer currently working on the soundtrack for the game. I can’t quite say just yet who that person is (stay tuned for an upcoming announcement on that!), but I can say this person has done the soundtracks for a couple other games you have all heard of and the soundtracks for those games are so good that professional orchestras perform them around the world.[b] [STATUS: Under Development][/b]

[h1]Art[/h1]

We have recently expanded our team to include a new artist. We will announce him more formally soon (Peter wants to get some more concept art completed first). He comes as a personal recommendation by the Art Director of another very well-known game I am sure you have all heard of. The general art direction will be updated graphics to be more in line with other modern games people are playing. First we are starting with the buildings and then our thought is to redo terrain followed by the various troops themselves. [b][STATUS: Under Development][/b]

[h1][b]UI/HUD[/b][/h1]

Our Game Designer has been hard at work retooling the way the GUI is set up. We are going to do a complete overhaul of the whole thing, including the General Lobby, the Match Lobby as well as the in game HUD. We have been getting a lot of great suggestions on how this should be set up and I think people will be pleased by what they see. [b][STATUS: Under Development][/b]

[h1]Gameplay Features[/h1]

We have a lot of exciting stuff coming for general game play. Besides improving the overall performance of the game itself we will be improving the AI of the troops so they also perform better. Additionally, a proper tutorial will go in that should help new players who are just learning the game and may even help skilled players become just that much better at things. Also on the list is proper formations so that it is easier for players to control their armies and add that next layer of battlefield strategy.[b] [STATUS - Upcoming][/b]

[h1]Heroes[/h1]

We plan on introducing another popular suggestion made by many people - Heroes! These will be special troops with various abilities and not just your run-of-the-mill footsoldiers. I can’t go into much detail just yet, but know they are on the books. [b][STATUS - Upcoming]
[/b]

[h1]Online Store[/h1]

Since Dawn Rises is a free to play game, we will be implementing a cash shop. However, this will NOT be a pay-to-win shop. Nothing offered there will benefit one player’s game balance over another simply because one spent some money while the other did not. General things that will be available includes Troop/Building models, various skins for those models, different unit icons, expanded Taunts and sounds, etc.[b] [STATUS - Upcoming][/b]

[h1]eSports[/h1]

We have the goal to eventually turn this game into an eSport. We know that in it’s current form Dawn Rises needs a little reworking to gear things more in the direction of a competitive game. Plans are to speed up the overall game play so that things happen faster and average match time is cut down. Communication between players and especially team members is important for this of course, so we will also be improving those aspects as well. In the near future we will be announcing some details on plans for having actual tournaments for people to compete in as well as the company we have partnered with to provide some quality prizes. [b][STATUS - Upcoming][/b]

[h1]Player Stats[/h1]

As part of the eSports thing, we will be adding in a whole bunch more game statistics. This will make it so that you can easily see where you stand on a variety of different aspects and also how you stack up against other players. [b][STATUS - Upcoming][/b]

I hope that all gives a general look at the direction that we will be heading. Community Manager, Animus Interactive

notes.title: Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises is now FREE TO PLAY!
notes.content:
[h1][/h1]
[h1] The real time strategy game, Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises is FREE TO PLAY.[/h1]

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/goesfreetoplay.png[/img]

You can pick it up [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/329280]FOR FREE in the Steam Store.[/url]

[h1]What's our reason for doing this?[/h1]
We understand that there are many people out there who shy away from any game that is in Early Access. However, something that simple should not stop people from being able to enjoy the game and, equally important, being able to give their feedback and suggestions. We would like to create the best game that we can and the more people we have sharing their ideas and opinions, the better off we are.

This is not going to effect production in any way shape or form. As a matter of fact, we just implemented a few very exciting things including taunts and a new map and we are working on some new music and concept art at this very moment. We will have some amazing announcements for you moving forward.

[h1]What about the money I spent for the game already?[/h1]
We realize that you have payed your hard earned money for the game so, we have some things to offer you in compensation. First, once the game shop goes in, we will credit you $30USD in shop assets for you to enjoy – even if you bought the game on sale. Secondly, we have a very well known composer working on the official soundtrack for Dawn Rises (stay tuned to further announcements to find out exactly who!) and we will send you a digital copy of the soundtrack once it is complete. You will also get the ability to play on nightly builds, so you get to see fixes as they get put in before official patch releases. Finally, we will give you access to our private internal Discord chat server where you will be able to speak directly to the staff here at Animus Interactive and help shape the game even more with an insider's track.

[h1]What if I have questions? I need more information![/h1]
If you have any questions, comments or concerns, there are a few things that you can do.
[list]
	[*]Drop an email to our Community Manager, Chris Schoolcraft at cschoolcraft@animusinteractive.com. Chris is the go to guy and will answer all of your questions quickly and efficiently.[/*]
	[*]Post on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/329280/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url]. Chris is super active on there. I'm surprised he even sleeps at all![/*]
	[*]Ask us on [url=https://twitter.com/avalonlords]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/AvalonLordsDawnRises/]Facebook[/url]. Follow our social media to get instant updates about what's going on.[/*]
	[*]Watch our [url=http://www.twitch.tv/animusinteractive]Live Stream on Twitch![/url] We are live 5 days a week.[/*]
[/list]
May your sword be quick and your shield be light. For Avalon!

notes.title: Program With Us Episode 34 - Milestones and Fixes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings Avalonians![/b][/h1]
This week we've been hard at work on [u]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises, [/u]and we've got lots of news to share! If you didn't manage to join us for our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bG7B6R3sVnQ]Thursday Night [u][b]Program With Us[/b][/u] Livestream[/url] you can catch up here:

https://youtu.be/bG7B6R3sVnQ

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/Paladin-AL-logo.png[/img]

[h1]Player Feedback And Future Milestones[/h1]

This week we've had all sorts of feedback from our community about the game, which really helps us understand which issues and updates are most important to you. We've been reading and discussing your feedback and appreciate all of it, so please keep it coming!

[h1]Milestones We Are Currently Focusing On:[/h1]

[b]Performance Tuning:[/b] We know that not everyone is running our game on a brand new gaming computer, so one of our major focuses is on improving performance.

[b]Troop Formations:[/b] These have already been designed but need a little more work. We hope to have them back in game and working properly in a future update. [url=http://www.avalonlords.com/news/program-with-us-episode-23-highlights-spectator-gui-improvements-and-army-formations/]You can read more about the Troop Formations we have planned here.[/url]

[b]Walls:[/b] We've had lots of feedback and suggestions relating to Walls. This is something we're committed to getting right, and we're working on it. See this week's fixes below for a new way to add Gates in game!

[b]GUI Updates: [/b] The GUI currently have in game is not the final version, and you can expect to see more changes. Let us know what you think of them!

[b]Extra Maps:[/b] Many of you have asked about extra maps. You can definitely expect to see more maps included in the game between now and launch.

[b]Empire Mode:[/b] If you enjoy Empire Mode but want to see more features, we have good news! More features are planned for Empire Mode, and we'll be telling you more about that closer to implementation.

[b]WASD Keys:[/b] Many of you have commented on the way WASD keys work when you're using the Build Menu. We will be implementing a fix that allows you to move as you build in a future patch.

[i][b]Thanks to everyone who commented on Steam Discussions, wrote a review, chatted to us in the Livestream or posted on the Forums - your feedback is essential to the completion of Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises![/b][/i]

[h1]This Week's Fixes And Updates[/h1]

This week, we've been hard at work tracking down bugs and adding new in-game functions! These include:
[list]
	[*][b]Walls and Gates: [/b]You can now upgrade a section of Wall to a Gate by selecting a section of wall and pressing 'J'. An in-game button will follow. This workaround should make Gates easier to build - let us know how it works for you![/*]

	[*][b]Available Matches: [/b]The Available Matches window now shows all current matches from all three multiplayer modes. Click to join or spectate.[/*]
	[*][b]In-game Descriptions for Research: [/b]These and other descriptions have been added.[/*]
	[*][b]Notifications:[/b]
[list]
	[*]The notification that pops up when you need more resources to build has been replaced with a simpler text notification.[/*]
	[*]When you mouse over a banner, it now displays information about units in that Squad.[/*]
	[*]When you mouse over an enemy Banner, the mouse cursor now displays as a sword. This should make it easier to spot your enemies![/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Private Messaging: [/b]You can now send Private Messages to people in your Steam Friends List by selecting them from your Friends List on the Home Screen.[/*]
	[*][b]Text Corrections: [/b]Negative % values have been removed from the Research Text, and a few typos have been hunted down and fixed. Let us know if you spot any more![/*]
	[*][b]View Reload Animations: [/b]You can now see Reload Animations on moving Trebuchets and Mount Horse Animations on Scouts! To see the animation follow these steps:
[list]
	[*]Build a Trebuchet/ recruit a Scout and order it to move towards a destination[/*]
	[*]Pan the screen ahead of the Unit, then pan back[/*]
	[*]The Unit will stop momentarily and show the Reload Animation![/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]GUI Updates:[/b]  The in-game GUI has been updated! You can see the current form below:[/*]
[/list]

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/New-GUI-1.jpg[/img]

[i][b]You can keep tabs on the latest known bugs by taking a look at our [url=http://www.avalonlords.com/news/known-bugs-and-issues-list/]Known Bugs and Issues List![/url] This is updated every few days as new bugs are reported and older ones are fixed. If you do find a bug, you can report it right here on our [url=http://www.avalonlords.com/forums/board/support/alpha-bugs/]Website Forum,[/url] or on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/329280/discussions/6/]Steam Discussion Forums![/url][/b][/i]

[h1]Screenshot of the Week![/h1]

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/329280_screenshots_20160505214054_1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=http://www.twitch.tv/animusinteractive]Don't forget you can join us on Twitch Monday-Friday for our daily broadcasts:[/url] [/b][/h1]

[b][url=http://www.twitch.tv/animusinteractive]MONDAY at Noon PDT | 3pm EDT | 8pm BST[/url][/b]

notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Avalonians![/h1]

This week, we returned to our usual Twitch Stream schedule to bring you the latest [i]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/i] news and updates! If you didn't manage to catch the stream, you can watch it here:

https://youtu.be/9agYwbqSrRw

[h1]Learn More About [i]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/i] With Our New Video Tutorials![/h1]

Indie and the team have been hard at work creating some video tutorials to introduce new players to the game and show them how to use different features. We hope these videos will make it a little easier to get started in game. Let us know what you think in the YouTube comments!

https://youtu.be/uqamM3ttrlI

[h1]So, What's New?[/h1]

[b]Here are just a few of the improvements we've made this week![/b]

[b]Scouts have now been nerfed[/b], as they were a little too powerful in the last version. A Scout can now be killed by two Peasants, which makes them less dangerous to face early in the game. Scouts are designed to be fast moving reconnaissance troops rather than heavy hitting cavalry.

[b]The tutorial has been temporarily removed[/b] for some behind-the-scenes fixes. It will be back soon, better than ever!

[b]AI players can no longer place buildings in water.[/b] While we enjoyed seeing their under-sea cities, they are all now firmly on dry land where they belong!

[b]You can now click on enemy troop banners to attack them[/b], just as you can click your own troop's banners to give them orders. This is still a little buggy and is still being tweaked, but it should make it easier to target your enemies!

[b]Unit optimization[/b] - this week our CTO David Wu has been hard at work optimizing troop combat, which means our troops should move more smoothly. This should make a noticeable difference to gameplay.

[b]Steam achievements[/b] are now working correctly! It's fantastic to see so many of you ticking them off!

steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=679255880

[h1]Still To Come[/h1]

This week, we'll be working on Wall functionality and improving the UI, so you should see some changes to those in the near future!

[h1]Reporting Bugs and Issues[/h1]

Thanks to everyone who joined us in game and gave us feedback this week - your bug reports and suggestions are exactly what we need to make [i]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/i] the best RTS out there. [b]Don't forget you can keep tabs on the latest known bugs by taking a look at our [url=http://www.avalonlords.com/news/known-bugs-and-issues-list/]Known Bugs and Issues List![/url] This is updated every few days as new bugs are reported and older ones are fixed. This week our very own Dan 'Indie' Long was invited along to the Sam Skatch Show to talk about [i]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/i] and Pax East. [url=http://wasdradio.com/2016/05/sam-skatch-ep75-pax-east-follow-up-avalon-lords/]You can listen to the podcast here![/url]

steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=674309936

[h1][b]Greetings Avalonians![/b][/h1]
[b]On Thursday we revealed some exciting new updates, including our brand new persistent multiplayer mode, Empire Mode! [/b]

We've also got UI updates, updated textures and new sound effects to show off! If you didn't manage to catch the stream, you can watch it here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=23biSHoevmg

[h1]Introducing Empire Mode![/h1]
Join friends and allies to battle other player-led factions in this rich, multiplayer campaign. Dominance is key, and controlling the most territory leads to victory. Winning this multi-week campaign will require the best of your wit, skill, and endurance. More to be revealed soon!

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/Empire-Mode.jpg[/img] Introducing Empire Mode, the new multiplayer campaign in Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises!


[h1]Animus Interactive Goes To PAX East![/h1]
Later this week we'll be showing off [u]Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises[/u] at PAX East! If you're planning to attend, you can find us right here in [b]Hall B on Level 0, Booth 10219.[/b] We really look forward to seeing you there, so stop by, say hello and check out the game!

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/PAX_EAST_ANIMUS_MAP_copy.png[/img] Find us at PAX East and check out Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises!

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/paxeast.jpg[/img] Come visit us Booth 10219, Hall B on Level 0 to check out Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises!

We also have some new sound effects to show off! Check them out in this short highlight video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=76QEfwIlEXI

This week we've given the terrain a makeover with stunning new textures and environmental effects:

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/New-Terrain-Texture-in-Avalon-Lords-Dawn-Rises.jpg[/img] Check out our updated terrain textures!

We've also retextured the Swordsman, Veteran Swordsman and Longbowman to get them looking their best for launch!

[h1]New UI[/h1]
Our UI has also been updated, with new build menus for Peasants, a new minimap and updated chat!

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/New-UI.jpg[/img] New UI features revealed!

[h1]New Steam Guides  Released![/h1]
Our Community Manager Knightmare has been hard at work preparing some useful Steam Guides to help you get to grips with the game. If you're not part of our testing group, these guides should make for useful pre-launch reading! [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=662118196]You can find them here - please check back regularly for updates as the game progresses![/url]

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/steam_logo_72872.jpg[/img] Find brand new Avalon Lords player guides on Steam!

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/pax-east-1280jpg-0a587a_1280w.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]What’s New?[/b][/h1]
[h1]Upcoming Giveaways[/h1]
We'll be announcing our first Avalon Lords giveaways in the very near future! As well as being able to enter multiple times, you can also earn extra entries by sharing it with friends. We have now implemented some new in-game menus, making the game easier to navigate! The new GUI also gives you a full breakdown of your match statistics, level and other stats. This should make it easier to track your progress and see how you're doing.

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/in-game-menu-copy-300x199.jpg[/img]

We have also been putting together Steam cards and Achievements for the game. We'd like to give a special shout-out to community member Dondergod, who has been an amazing help. Thank you Dondergod!

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/steam_logo_72872.jpg[/img]

[h1][img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/Archer-last-stand-1024x576.jpg[/img][/h1]

notes.title: Program With Us Episode 29 Highlights – We’re Going To PAX East!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Avalonians![/h1]

This week we’ve got some exciting news to share. We’re delighted to announce that we will be at PAX East in Boston from April 22nd – 24th! [b]If you’re planning on heading to PAX, you’ll be able to find us in Hall B on Level 0, Booth 10219.[/b] 
Stop by to check out the game and pick up a coupon for a discount at launch!

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/paxeast.jpg[/img]

Come visit us Booth 10219, Hall B on Level 0 to check out Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises and pick up a coupon for a discount at launch!

 
[h1]Announcing Our New Monday Stream For EU Viewers![/h1]

Next week we’ll be starting a brand new Twitch stream for our EU fans! This will air on Mondays at [b]12pm PST/ 3pm EST/ 8pm GMT/ 9PM CEST.[/b] We look forward to seeing you there!

[h1]This Week[/h1]

On Thursday, we took a look at changes to Houses, Archery Towers and a few game mechanics, and tried out some tactical gameplay. If you didn’t manage to catch the stream you can catch up here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=11SvxTh-Ybo

[h1]So, What’s New?[/h1]

[h1]Changes to Houses and Farms[/h1]

The capacity of Houses has increased, so each House you build will now increase your Population Cap even more:
[list][*]Level 1 Houses now hold 10 Units (previously 5)[/*][/list][list][*]Level 2 Houses now hold 30 Units (previously 10)[/*][/list][list][*]Level 3 Houses now hold 60 Units (previously 15)[/*][/list]
This should make for some interesting changes to early gameplay, as players can now recruit Peasants and Offensive Units more quickly.

Farm levels have now been removed, and all Farms remain at Level 1.

[h1]Using Archery Towers as Bunkers[/h1]

The way that Archery Towers work has changed. Ranged Units placed within Archery Towers are now protected from damage until the Archery Tower has been destroyed by enemy troops, allowing you to use them as bunkers. We will also be updating Archery Towers to hold more Squads of Units in the very near future:
[list][*]Level 1 Archery Towers will hold two Squads[/*][*]Level 2 Archery Towers will hold four Squads[/*][/list]

Ranged Units can now enter Archery Towers from any direction.

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/2016-02-27_00014.jpg[/img]

Incoming!!

 

[b]Troops stationed in Archery Towers can perform three actions:[/b]
[list][*]Scan horizon for enemy targets to engage[/*][*]Accept orders to attack enemy targets, as long as they are in range. If the target is not in range, Ranged Units will continue to scan for enemies[/*][*]Evacuate the Tower[/*][/list]

[h1]Archery Mechanics[/h1]

Ranged Units in Avalon Lords: Dawn Rises have a High Ground Bonus that allows them to do more damage when firing downhill. This allows you to use the terrain to your advantage by attacking from high ground and and trying to force your enemy to approach you from below. The damage buff is now set at 10%.

[h1]Charge Damage Buffs[/h1]

Troops charging towards an enemy and engaging them before their Charge timer runs out now gain a damage bonus, allowing them to do more damage to enemy troops when they hit them at a run.

[h1]Troop Formations and Combat[/h1]

Troop formations are now available for all Squads apart from Siege Units. On Thursday’s stream, Knightmare and Indie tested out the Loose and Tight formations to see how they fared against each other, and had a lot of fun in the process! Tight formations do more damage to their enemies, but move more slowly and are more vulnerable to ranged and siege attacks. Loose formations can cover ground more quickly, and being spread out makes them harder for Ranged and Siege units to target, but they do not do as much damage as those in a Tight formation.

The way in which Squads of Units move and attack has also changed. Units now turn individually when ordered to rotate, and when a Squad engages, every Unit in the Squad attacks at once.

[h1]Screenshot of the Week[/h1]

[img]http://wordpress-avalonlords.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/Kath-4.jpg[/img]
Hilltop Blacksmith
[h1][url=http://www.twitch.tv/animusinteractive][b][i]Don’t forget to tune to Program with Us every Thursday at 6pm PDT | 9pm EDT for all the latest updates and a chance to win game keys and more![/i][/b][/url][/h1]

notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Avalonians![/h1]

Welcome to this week’s news update! If you missed last night’s Program With Us you can watch it here:

https://youtu.be/12p644gUcTQ

This week, PR manager Indie filled us in on the latest Avalon Lords developments, which testers can now try out in game.

[h1]Updated Farms[/h1]

Farms no longer have to be replaced when they run out of food, which saves you having to rebuild them. Once a Farm has been built, it will produce Food as long as you have Peasants to work it.

[h1]Changes To Ranged Combat[/h1]

If you were finding it hard to escape your enemy’s arrows and projectiles; good news! All ranged attacks now take a little longer to hit, which means that players who are on the ball will have a chance to move their troops out of harm’s way.

[h1]New Units In The Army Builder[/h1]

Testers can now add the latest units to the Army Builder and try them out in Combat Mode. You can now add all Cavalry and Artillery units to pre-selected armies.

[h1]Screenshot Of The Week[/h1]

[img]http://www.avalonlords.com/wp-content/uploads/Kath-2-1024x576.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Avalonians![/h1]

Welcome to our weekly news post. If you missed last week’s stream, you can find it right here:

https://youtu.be/7mJsh22cE4c

[h1]Mounted Troops Now In Game![/h1]

It’s been an exciting week here at Animus Interactive – this is the week where we add our long-awaited mounted troops – the Cavalry Units.
